scenes.narration: Di peta mana pun, pulau ini tidak ada.
scenes.visual: Near-black night sea. Faint wave lines roll in and out, a dim silhouette of a tiny island on the horizon. Top-right counter 'PENDUDUK: 1' blinks slowly. A faint map grid fades in; the island's spot is marked with a question mark.

scenes.narration: Namanya Aru. Ia terbangun di pantai, tanpa ingat bagaimana ia sampai di sini.
scenes.visual: Dawn colours bloom. Close on Aru lying on wet sand; eyes open on 'terbangun', he sits up, drips fall. Camera pulls back slowly: a tiny island, one coconut palm, nobody else, sea all around.

scenes.narration: Ia berteriak sampai suaranya habis. Tapi satu-satunya yang menjawab hanyalah ombak.
scenes.visual: Daylight. Aru runs along the shore leaving a trail of footprints, hands cupped to his mouth, shout lines. Gulls lift off and fly away. On 'ombak' a wave washes over the shore.

scenes.narration: Malam pertama adalah yang paling panjang. Ternyata sepi itu bukan soal tidak ada suara. Sepi itu ketika tidak ada yang tahu kamu ada.
scenes.visual: Night. Huge starry sky, the island small at the bottom. Aru hugs his knees by a tiny flickering campfire; sparks drift up. Slow zoom out makes the island feel smaller and lonelier.

scenes.narration: Pagi harinya, ia menulis satu surat: 'Kalau ada yang menemukan ini… aku di sini. Datanglah.'
scenes.visual: Morning. Aru writes on paper with charcoal, rolls it into a glass bottle and throws it; the bottle arcs into the sea and bobs, growing as it floats toward the camera.
The bottle grows huge and hits the screen: flash, fine cracks spread over the glass. A paper scroll unrolls facing the viewer with handwritten text: 'Kalau kamu membaca ini, kamu sudah menemukanku.'

scenes.narration: Setiap orang yang mengikuti pulau ini akan menjadi warganya. Setiap hari, dua dari kalian akan memutuskan apa yang terjadi selanjutnya.
scenes.visual: Back on the island in golden afternoon. Aru stands at the end of an unfinished wooden jetty facing the viewer, waving. The counter ticks with a pulse. Ghostly silhouettes of future residents twinkle in on the horizon; two of them light up on 'dua'.

scenes.narration: Tulis di komentar. Besok, Aru tidak akan sendirian lagi.
scenes.visual: Sunset. Aru plants a blank wooden sign in the sand. Big text pops in: 'Pulau ini belum punya nama. Apa namanya?' The counter flips from 1 to 2, then the screen fades to dark.
